title: The Heritage Short
logline: A grandchild who never had patience for her grandmother's loom learns, too late and just in time, that the patterns were the family's only written history.
audience: PLACEHOLDER — e.g. 18–35 year-olds in diaspora families, watching on phones (9:16) and on a festival screen (16:9). Replace after user test 1.
intent: PLACEHOLDER — e.g. leave viewers wanting to ask an elder to teach them one thing before it is lost. Replace with your own one-sentence intent.

render.notes: Keyframes and the master are 16:9; the 9:16 export is a crop of the master guided by each shot's vertical_focus_x. Keep subjects near the chosen focus.

models.notes: image + tts use Cloudflare Workers AI (CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID / CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN in .env). video: Workers AI has no video model, so shots use Ken Burns. music: stub until Lyria billing or a licensed track (FAILURES.md F-100). `make film-offline` swaps every model to the stub provider. Fill `pricing` from the provider's pricing page; null means cost is logged as null.

params.style: Read warmly and unhurried, like a grandchild remembering

style.notes: Appended to every image prompt so the look stays consistent across shots.
style.image_prompt_suffix: warm natural window light, 35mm film still, shallow depth of field, muted earth tones with indigo and ochre accents, intimate documentary feel
style.negative_prompt: text, watermark, logo, extra fingers, deformed hands, oversaturated, plastic skin

voice.notes: voice_id is provider-specific. Gemini TTS prebuilt voices include Kore, Puck, Charon, Aoede, Leda, … (style instruction lives in models.tts.params.style). Cloudflare aura-2-en uses names like luna/athena. For macos_say use a system voice such as 'Samantha'.

music_cues.prompt: gentle solo kalimba and soft strings, nostalgic, 70 bpm, no vocals
sparse low cello drone, hushed, almost silent, no percussion
warm hopeful strings and kalimba returning, slow build, resolves

shots.purpose: Establish the grandmother through her hands, not her face.
shots.reason: Hands are the film's central motif; opening on them sets up the final line.
shots.image_prompt: extreme close-up of an elderly woman's weathered hands resting on a wooden hand loom, threads in indigo and ochre
shots.motion_prompt: very slow push-in, fingers twitch slightly, dust motes drift in the light
shots.narration: My grandmother never wrote anything down. Everything she knew lived in her hands.

shots.purpose: Show the ritual and the sound world of the loom.
shots.reason: Gives the audience a rhythm to lose later in s05.
shots.image_prompt: wide shot of a small sunlit room on a Sunday morning, an elderly woman weaving at a wooden loom, a child playing on the floor in the background
shots.motion_prompt: static camera, the shuttle moves left to right, curtains sway
shots.narration: On Sunday mornings the house filled with the clack of her loom, steady as a heartbeat.

shots.purpose: Reveal that the patterns are a language.
shots.reason: The key idea of the film; must be legible in under 8 seconds.
shots.image_prompt: top-down macro shot of handwoven cloth showing a zigzag river motif and small eight-pointed stars, indigo on ochre
shots.motion_prompt: slow pan along the weave following the zigzag
shots.narration: Each pattern meant something. A zigzag for the river her family crossed. A star for every child born.

shots.reason: Creates the regret the second half resolves.
shots.image_prompt: a teenage girl on a couch absorbed in her phone, the loom blurred in the foreground, late afternoon light
shots.motion_prompt: rack focus from loom to girl, she does not look up
shots.narration: As a kid, I thought it was just thread. I was too busy to sit still.

shots.purpose: The turn: age and loss of skill.
shots.reason: Music drops out here so the silence does the work.
shots.image_prompt: close-up of elderly trembling hands failing to pass a shuttle through threads, cold blue winter light
shots.motion_prompt: handheld subtle drift, hands tremble, shuttle slips
shots.narration: Then her hands began to shake. One winter, the loom went quiet, and the house felt smaller.

shots.reason: A concrete object to carry the emotion; motivates the ask in s07.
shots.image_prompt: a wooden drawer opened to reveal a folded, half-finished handwoven cloth with a wooden shuttle tucked inside
shots.motion_prompt: slow tilt down into the drawer
shots.narration: I found her last cloth folded in a drawer, half finished, the shuttle still tucked inside.
shots.notes: skip_video=true: deliberately uses the Ken Burns fallback (a still object benefits little from generated motion).

shots.purpose: The ask: the narrator chooses to learn.
shots.reason: Active choice by the protagonist; the emotional pivot.
shots.image_prompt: young woman seated at the loom, her elderly grandmother beside her guiding her fingers with her own, warm lamp light
shots.motion_prompt: slow orbit around the two pairs of hands
shots.narration: So I asked her to teach me. She couldn't weave anymore, but she could still guide my fingers.

shots.reason: Lightens tone before the ending; shows effort, not talent.
shots.image_prompt: medium shot of a grandmother laughing warmly while her granddaughter frowns at a tangled weave, cozy room
shots.motion_prompt: gentle push-in, grandmother laughs, granddaughter sighs and smiles
shots.narration: Over, under, pull. I got it wrong a hundred times. She laughed every single time.

shots.purpose: Payoff: the language continues with a new symbol.
shots.reason: Pays off s03's star-per-child rule with the next generation.
shots.image_prompt: macro shot of freshly woven cloth where a zigzag river and stars appear, one new star woven in bright thread
shots.motion_prompt: slow pan ending on the new bright star
shots.narration: Slowly the zigzag appeared. Then the stars. Then a new one, for my daughter.

shots.purpose: Close the loop on hands; state the theme.
shots.reason: Mirrors s01 with three generations of hands.
shots.image_prompt: three pairs of hands of different generations, elderly, adult and a small child, resting together on a finished handwoven cloth
shots.motion_prompt: slow pull-back, the child's fingers trace a star
shots.narration: Some things can't be written down. They have to be passed from hand to hand.

end_card.title: The Heritage Short
